title: Downloads follow the filters, sort and shown columns
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 4 S4-R3 Reports Story 1 S1-R14 Reports Story 3 S3-R8)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 20, archived after customer B's invoice.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, put on tier B for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $108.00 by tier B, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customers A and B in the Customer filter.
  3. Untick Parts Cost in the Columns list.
  4. Click the Parts Invoiced heading.
  5. Click Download Summary (CSV) in the ⋯ menu.
  6. Click Download Summary (PDF) in the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • Tier A reads $121.50 and tier B (archived) $108.00.

Step 3:

  • Parts Cost is hidden.

Step 4:

  • Tier A ($121.50) is above tier B ($108.00).

Step 5:

  • The CSV lists tier A before tier B, with customers A and B's figures ($121.50 + $108.00 = $229.50 in Totals).
  • It has no Parts Cost column.
  • Tier A reads its number and name; tier B reads its name with "(archived)".
  • The CSV's other columns are the ones shown on screen.

Step 6:

  • The PDF shows the same rows, order, columns and labels as the CSV.
